STORY OF US

A Land of Timeless Heritage and Natural Wonder

Malaysia is a vibrant melting pot of cultures, where ancient traditions coexist with modern aspirations. Out land is defined by lush, millions of years rainforest, crystal coastal waters, and a spirit of hospitality that uniquely malaysian.

TOURISM & HERITAGE

Living Traditions

Craft heritage that preserves identity for future generations.

The Timeless Art of Malaysian Songket

Known as the “Queen of Fabrics, Songket is a rich tapesty woven with gold or silver threads. This centuries old craft represents the pinnacle of Malaysian textile heritage, often worn during royal ceremonies and festive occasions.

Other Tourism

Geographic Conditions

Malaysia is geographically divided into two main regions, West Malaysia (Peninsular) and East Malaysia (Borneo), separated by the South China Sea. With an equatorial tropical climate, Malaysia has mountains in the west and swampy lowlands in the east, with biodiverse tropical rainforests and a long coastline.

Watch Nature

OUR SIGNATURE DISH

Nasi Lemak

Considered Malaysia's national dish, nasi lemak combines fragrant coconut rice, spicy sambal, crunchy anchovies, roasted peanuts, and fresh cucumber. It is a flavorful symbol of local identity, enjoyed from street stalls to modern restaurants.

CULTURE

Everyday Warmth in Malaysia

Malay, Chinese, Indian, and indigenous roots blend into shared rituals, flavours, and art forms that stay humble yet full of colour.

Hospitality Harmony Gotong-royong Open House
  • Living traditions: Batik, songket, woodcarving, and storytelling passed down at home.
  • Festivals collide: Hari Raya, Chinese New Year, Deepavali, Gawai, and Kaamatan keep streets lively all year.
  • Food as glue: From kopitiam breakfasts to night markets, sharing plates is how friendships grow.

Anwar Ibrahim

Anwar Ibrahim

Malaysia’s 10th Prime Minister, sworn in on 24 November 2022, long known for his reformist voice and coalition-building across communities.

50+ years Public service & activism
MADANI Inclusive nation framework
  • Founded ABIM youth movement; championed education and social justice.
  • Held key ministerial roles (Education, Finance) before leading today’s unity government.
  • Focuses on anti-corruption, targeted subsidies, and balanced ties across ASEAN and global partners.
